The test image shows a soybean field where the central plant appears to have died prematurely — brown/dried stems and pods while surrounding plants remain green. This points to a late-season stem/pod disease. Key candidates: Diaporthe (pod and stem blight), Sudden_death_syndrome, or Phytophthora.

Let me view the Diaporthe reference since the dried pods and stems are the dominant symptom.

The Diaporthe reference image (top-left panel) shows an exact match: a plant that has prematurely senesced/died in a field of green plants, with dried brown pods and stems — identical to the test image. The other panels show the characteristic stem features (gray-brown with linear black specks/pycnidia).
